name: agentic-rwa-treasury
description: An auditable AI-managed ERC-4626 RWA treasury for X Layer.

scripts.dev: bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/web dev
scripts.dev:web: bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/web dev
scripts.dev:agent: bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/agent dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/agent build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/agent typecheck && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/contracts typecheck && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared test && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/agent test && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/contracts test && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/web test
scripts.agent:epoch: bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/agent epoch
scripts.agent:worker: bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/agent worker
scripts.agent:smoke: bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/agent smoke
scripts.check: bun run validate:repo && bun run static:check && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run contracts:compile && bun run build
scripts.agent:verify: bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/shared build && bun run --filter @agentic-rwa/agent verify:reasoning --
scripts.validate: bun run validate:repo && bun run static:check
